acceptance.statement: Processed imitation candidate calls the existing Research HTTP endpoint (POST /api/research-orchestrator/intake/imitation-candidate).
Research readback via GET /api/research-orchestrator/runs/{run_id} returns exact task_id and run_id identity.
Direct ResearchOrchestratorStore import is removed from policy-learning handoff and replay is idempotent.
Research candidate HTTP client defaults to http://research-orchestrator-svc:8101 (matching existing compose owner) and falls back to RESEARCH_ORCHESTRATOR_URL env var.

proof: Replay test test_idempotent_replay_http_intake verifies that repeated POST intake returns identical task_id and run_id without duplicate run creation.
test_http_intake_and_readback_error_handling verifies connection error and readback identity mismatch fail closed with ResearchCandidateClientError and CandidateHandoffError.
Intake receipt attaches task_id, run_id, candidate_id, created_at, and raw_response to candidate record after exact readback confirmation.
test_research_service_url_routing verifies default URL matches http://research-orchestrator-svc:8101 and supports both RESEARCH_SERVICE_URL and RESEARCH_ORCHESTRATOR_URL environment variables.
